resources.description: Look up a UK postcode: coordinates, country, region, council, ward, parish, parliamentary constituency, and ONS/NHS area codes.
Autocomplete a partial UK postcode into a list of full postcode suggestions.
Validate a UK postcode and report its normalised form, format validity, and whether it is currently active.
Find UK postcodes within a radius (100-2000m) of a lat/lng, each with its distance in metres from the query point.
Search UK postcodes by free-text address or place query; returns up to 100 matching postcode records.
